metrics.name: Waitlist sign-ups captured
metrics.description: Seller/garage/distributor waitlist submissions successfully persisted and delivered to the founding team (the site's primary conversion). Supports the 'first 300 shops at 0%' promo.
metrics.target: Every submission captured with zero data loss; funnel live before the next Early Adaptor field push
metrics.measurement: Count of stored waitlist records / notifications received by the team

metrics.name: Design fidelity to approved prototype
metrics.description: The deployed site matches the reviewed Claude Design prototype section-for-section, including the 3D hero fitment scene, AI-catalog animation, Indonesia flyover map, and all approved copy in both languages.
metrics.target: Visual/copy parity signed off by Yavet against the design project (checkpoint 3.2 state)
metrics.measurement: Side-by-side review of deployed site vs design prototype, EN and ID

metrics.name: Bilingual experience quality
metrics.description: EN/ID toggle works across every section of both pages, persists across visits, and the ID copy is the naturalized text from the design (not re-translated).
metrics.target: 100% of i18n keys rendered correctly in both languages
metrics.measurement: i18n key coverage check + manual review of both language modes

metrics.name: Mobile performance and accessibility
metrics.description: Most seller traffic arrives via WhatsApp on mid-range Android phones; the page must load fast and stay usable, and heavy 3D scenes must degrade gracefully (reduced-motion, static fallbacks).
metrics.target: Good Core Web Vitals on mobile (LCP < 2.5s on 4G mid-range device); prefers-reduced-motion respected
metrics.measurement: Lighthouse/PageSpeed mobile run on the production URL

metrics.name: Site live on production URL
metrics.description: Repo https://github.com/piztanza/mobeeli-landing-page.git holds the code and the site is deployed and reachable (production hosting/domain decided at strategy phase).
metrics.target: Deployed and publicly reachable, landing + join-waitlist pages both live
metrics.measurement: Production URL check; repo main branch builds green
